chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Eat dates on an empty stomach (with saliva), for it kills the worms in the stomach.
The author of this book - may God have mercy upon him - said: By this, he means to eat all dates except the Barni variety, for eating that variety on an empty stomach causes hemiplegia.

key_terms.الرِّيق: Saliva; here referring to eating on an empty stomach before drinking water or eating other food
key_terms.الْبَرْنِيَّ: A specific variety of date known for its properties
key_terms.الْفَالِج: Hemiplegia (paralysis of one side of the body)

ai.seo_question: What is the health benefit of eating dates on an empty stomach and which variety should be avoided?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the Prophetic tradition of consuming dates on an empty stomach (*ala al-riq*) for their medicinal properties, specifically as an anthelmintic to expel intestinal worms. Shaykh al-Saduq provides a nuanced scholarly clarification, noting that while this practice is beneficial for most date varieties, the Barni type is an exception, as eating it on an empty stomach is believed to induce hemiplegia (stroke), illustrating the early Islamic understanding of dietary specificity in health maintenance.
